title: Kernel auto-selection v2: seq-length bucketing + prefill/decode regime signal
author: Lena Fischer
description: Context: Kernel auto-selection v2 needs a stable signal for workload regime so we can avoid long-context tail latency spikes and reduce mis-selections across heterogeneous fleets. v1 implicitly assumed prompt length ~ short and used coarse heuristics around max_seq_len; that breaks for mixed prefill/decode patterns and long-context (large prefill + small decode). This PR introduces (1) deterministic seq-length bucketing on request features and (2) a prefill/decode regime signal that the selector can consume without depending on dynamic runtime timing. Summary of changes: Adds SeqLenBucket + WorkloadRegime feature extraction in the selector input builder; adds small, bounded heuristic to derive regime from (prompt_tokens, max_new_tokens) and optionally observed decode ratio when available; wires features into selector context (but does not change final kernel decision rules yet—those are in the core-decision-logic PR); adds lightweight CI benchmarks for bucket classification stability + micro perf sanity checks; updates docs/comments for determinism expectations. Buckets: prompt_tokens buckets [0-128, 129-512, 513-2k, 2k-8k, 8k+]; decode_tokens buckets [0-32, 33-128, 129-512, 512+]. WorkloadRegime is derived as one of {prefill_heavy, decode_heavy, balanced, long_context_prefill} with thresholds chosen to be monotonic and stable across retries. Determinism: feature extraction is pure function of request + static config; no dependence on wall-clock timing; no reliance on GPU counters. CI/bench: adds a small "selector_features_smoke" benchmark that runs on CPU in CI and validates classification across a canned set of request shapes, plus a time-budget assertion to keep extraction overhead < ~5us per request on dev machines (non-blocking warn locally, blocking in CI only if > 20us). Follow-ups: core decision rules will consume these features in pr-28411 / pr-28522; scheduler-derived distribution hints (mixed workloads) will be handled in pr-28502.
commits: selector/features: add SeqLenBucket + WorkloadRegime enums and serialization
selector/features: implement deterministic bucketing and regime derivation
tests: add golden vectors for bucket/regime classification
bench: add lightweight CI benchmark for selector feature extraction overhead
docs: update comments on determinism (no timing-derived signals)
notable_snippet: Bucketing logic (illustrative): prompt_bucket = bucket(prompt_tokens, [128, 512, 2048, 8192]); decode_bucket = bucket(max_new_tokens, [32, 128, 512]); regime = (prompt_tokens >= 8192 && max_new_tokens <= 128) ? long_context_prefill : (prompt_tokens >= 4*max_new_tokens) ? prefill_heavy : (max_new_tokens >= 4*prompt_tokens) ? decode_heavy : balanced; // thresholds tuned in ENG-4822 notes
review_conversation: Noah Patel (review): Please justify thresholds for regime derivation. We need guardrails against jitter at boundary values and ensure monotonicity. Also: confirm no timing-based signal is introduced here.

Lena Fischer (author): Added comment + test vectors for boundary cases (exactly 4x ratios, bucket edges). Regime thresholds are monotonic in both prompt and decode; extraction is pure request-based. No timing/counters used. Also added a deterministic snapshot test for 40 canned shapes to avoid regressions.
Marcus Reed (review): The CI benchmark time check seems brittle. Can we make it non-flaky? Suggest only failing if extreme regression, and publish the number as a metric for tracking.
Lena Fischer (author): Adjusted: local asserts are warn-only; CI fails only if p95 > 20us on the runner. Also emits a stats line that perf-canary can scrape later (separate work).
Omar El-Sayed (review): Please ensure serialization doesn’t explode cardinality once we emit telemetry. Enums are fine, but avoid raw token counts.
Lena Fischer (author): Confirmed: selector feature payload uses bucket enums + regime only (no raw token counts). Added TODO comment referencing telemetry PR for sampling policy.
Yuki Sato (review): Looks good. Minor: rename long_context_prefill -> long_prefill to keep field length short; also ensure buckets match design doc (0-128 inclusive).
Lena Fischer (author): Renamed to long_prefill; bucket boundaries updated to be inclusive upper bounds as requested; tests updated accordingly.
Yuki Sato (approval): Approved. This unblocks v2 decision rules consuming stable regime signal.
release_notes: Runtime: Adds deterministic seq-length bucketing and prefill/decode regime classification for kernel auto-selection v2 feature extraction.
CI: Adds lightweight selector feature smoke benchmark to detect accidental overhead regressions.
